topics.name: DWH Write Operation Identity
topics.purpose: Define each DWH create/update/delete/materialize mutation as an explicit canonical operation with a distinct runtime execution identity and exact destination binding.

semantics.definition_rule: Mutation operation definition identity is separate from concrete write execution identity.
semantics.target_rule: Destination resolves exact instance/schema/resource/record identity before mutation.
semantics.schema_rule: Write payload validates against exact destination schema/field identities.
semantics.source_rule: If write derives from another value/query/tool/model, source provenance is retained.
semantics.authority_rule: Write requires normal AccessCore authorization and applicable assurance.
semantics.execution_rule: Concrete write receives distinct runtime execution identity.
semantics.event_rule: Successful/failed mutation may emit explicit Events referencing exact operation/execution/target.

invariants.rule: Every DWH mutation resolves an exact destination instance/schema/record/field identity, validates intended change, evaluates authorization and conflict state, and records provenance; no write is inferred from query/display context or silently overwrites conflicting accepted state.

hard_gates.condition: write target inferred from current UI row
